property_summary: For every possible contract state, calling paused() returns the actual paused flag (_paused) held by the contract; the mutant flips this value and thus will return the opposite for some states.

For any nonzero admin caller and any input address, the reference contract rejects setting lrtConfig to the zero address (updateLRTConfig reverts for lrtConfigAddr == address(0)), whereas the mutant accepts address(0) and sets lrtConfig to zero — so the property: calling updateLRTConfig with zero address must revert; the mutant breaks this.

For any caller that is an LRT admin, calling updateLRTConfig with the zero address must revert (reference enforces non-zero lrtConfigAddr); the mutant that removes the non-zero check will accept address(0) and thus violate this rule for some input.

For any caller that is the LRT admin, calling updateLRTConfig with the zero address MUST revert (reference enforces non-zero address), while the mutant that removed the non-zero check will accept address(0) and thus violate this rule for some inputs.

For any caller that is an LRT admin, calling updateLRTConfig with the zero address must revert (reference enforces non-zero lrtConfigAddr); the mutant that removed the non-zero check will accept address(0) and thus violate this rule for some input.
